title: Early pay-in of funds to ICCL (EPF)
purpose: Client purchases whose funds are paid in early to BSE Clearing: settlement, the firm's own clearing number as TM code, client and amount.
source: ICCL circular 20200829-4 (early pay-in cut-offs), as restated in BSECL's cut-off table and the cash master circular para 5.a. Built from the notice's description, not from a published file layout: ICCL has not published this file's column layout. The broker must confirm the field order, names and file name against ICCL's file description (member extranet) before the first upload.
